labour-relations-board: 1992 to Sep 1993 (Minister of Labour and Consumer Services era) not documented; no 1992 annual report found.

bc-ferry-corporation: gaps 1978-12 to 1982 (probably Transportation, Communications and Highways, unconfirmed), Feb 1998 to Jan 1999, Jul-Sep 1999, Nov 2000 to Jun 2001. 1995: annual reports tabled by Pement (Transportation) and MacPhail, ambiguous.
bc-housing: 1967-1975, 1978-1981, 1985-86, 1993-1999 not documented (Housing, Recreation and Consumer Services 1993-96 and Municipal Affairs and Housing 1996-99 likely but unconfirmed).

ocean-falls-corporation: 1976-1979 and 1985-86 not found (Premier Bennett answered some 1977 questions).
emergency-health-services-commission: 1974-2005 not documented from a body-specific source (Ministry of Health/Health Services assumed but not recorded).
bc-systems-corporation: 1992-1996 beyond the 1991-92 annual report not documented.
bc-games-society: 1977-2000 not found (Harcourt-era 'Minister Responsible for Sports' existed but no link to the Society found).
expo-86-corporation: 1979 and 1982-08 to 1984 not confirmed (Richmond as Minister of Tourism likely from 1982).
bc-pavilion-corporation: 1984 and 1991-2001 not found.

bc-transportation-financing-authority: 1994-1997 not documented.

bc-human-rights-commission: 2001-06 to 2003 not found (record 1997-2001 relies on the Attorney General holding the human-rights portfolio).
bc-assets-and-land-corporation: 1999-2001 not documented; 1998/99 has competing signals (Minister of Agriculture and Food message vs accountability to Minister of Finance and Corporate Relations).
bc-safety-authority: June 2005 to June 2008 not documented (Ministry of Community Services held 'safety standards' but the Authority is not named).

forestry-innovation-investment: body dates absent in input; records start with the 2004/05 service plan. The move from JEDI to Forests happened between the Feb 2025 and Feb 2026 plans (exact date not found).
